## Design

### 2026-10-08 – This 4.5-hour-long voyage started with figuring out what abilities I wanted my multi-tool to have, and ended with the PCB. I got this idea from my physics class, where we used an app that had things l

**4.5h**

This 4.5-hour-long voyage started with figuring out what abilities I wanted my multi-tool to have, and ended with the PCB. I got this idea from my physics class, where we used an app that had things like angle and temperature sensors, and I thought it would be cool to have an "analog" version.

This will be continued tomorrow with the parts list, and then in week two where it will become my CAD project. There was a bit of trouble with KiCAD not having the footprints i needed so I went old fashioned and did Comm 1x9 type things.
